requirements.requirement: Planter for a sunny kitchen windowsill
requirements.evidence: 3-cell linear arrangement (piece 0,0,0; 1,0,0; 0,-1,0) ~300mm long, compact for windowsill; three bins with soil provide planter function. Sunny location suitability is placement only; no material/UV claim.
bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 with basil-young, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 with mint-young, bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-div3 with parsley-young — all filled with soil and planted (prop:1,2,3 visible).

finish.summary: Built a compact 3-cell windowsill planter using three full-depth 3-compartment bins, each filled with soil and planted with a different herb (basil, mint, parsley). Capped and bolted, verified clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Sunny windowsill herb trio — I'll set up a compact planter for your three plants.
